vaults.name: Solstice Yield Looping
vaults.description:
The Solstice Yield Looping vault is a USD-denominated carry vault deploying across USX, PT-USX, PT-eUSX, and eUSX - vanilla and looped - on Exponent and Kamino.

The vault aims to outperform spot eUSX/PT-USX yield with bounded leverage, phased ramp and full observability.

Terms of service: https://allez.xyz/tos

vaults.name: Raiku SOL Ecosystem Vault
vaults.description:
A SOL yield product designed to deepen and support the rkuSOL ecosystem. LPs deposit and withdraw in rkuSOL; the vault deploys exclusively into rkuSOL-centric strategies across Exponent, Kamino, and Loopscale.

RockawayX abstracts multi-venue Solana DeFi execution into a single rkuSOL side deposit, with a balanced risk profile combining rkuSOL holding, Exponent yield trading (fixed yield PT-rkuSOL and its liquidity pool), and Kamino/Loopscale lending.

vaults.name: OnRe Growth
vaults.description:
OnRe Growth is a USDC-denominated yield vault that routes capital across three complementary expressions of OnRe's yield-bearing reinsurance token, ONyc: looped ONyc positions, lending against ONyc as collateral, and fixed-yield ONyc principal tokens (PTs). Deposits sit in USDC and are deployed across Loopscale, Kamino, and Exponent into the highest-conviction blend available.

The vault aims to deliver higher yield than holding ONyc spot while minimizing entry and exit slippage. This is done while preserving key risk controls including bounded leverage, transparent venue selection.
